title: GTA 6 Animated Series Gets First Official Trailer
summary: Rockstar finally shows off Macca & Friends

News Rockstar Games finally shows off Macca & Friends GTA 6 animated series gets first official trailer Image: Rockstar Games Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Grand Theft Auto 6 Sign in to your Polygon.com account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread 1 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap There is going to be a lot to do in Grand Theft Auto 6 when the game is released on Nov. 19. Players will, of course, be able to engage in the main story of Jason and Lucia, but there's going to be endless side activities as well. One of the strangest is Macca & Friends , an in-game animated series players will be able to watch. While you can already buy merch for the show, Rockstar Games hasn't actually shown off the series itself — until now. Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Discussing Film posted the first teaser for Macca & Friends , giving us our first look at the animated series. It follows the titular Macca, an anthropomorphic, sunglasses-wearing, pink alligator living his life in Leonida, Grand Theft Auto's version of Florida. His friends include Pinchie the crab, his landlord (who is not actually his friend), Chunkee the manatee, an unnamed flamingo, and a human cop. Macca will need to collect enough rent money to avoid getting kicked out. The show gives big Adult Swim energy and is clearly aimed at an older audience, which makes sense given everything about GTA. The teaser doesn't share how players will actually watch the show, though, given the level of immersion Rockstar is bringing to GTA 6 , it wouldn't be surprising if it is a full series that can be watched across multiple episodes. I'm sure we'll only get clarity once GTA 6 is released. You can buy Macca & Friends merch before GTA 6 is even out. Image: Rockstar Games If, somehow, the short teaser trailer really charmed you, you can already buy several knickknacks featuring Macca. Rockstar is offering the Grand Theft Auto 6 : The Good Time State — Vice City Collection for a whopping $399.99. While the special edition doesn't actually come with a copy of GTA 6 , it does come with a Macca figure and a Chunkee shot glass, among other things. Here's the full list of what you get in the Good Time State — Vice City Collection: Macca the Gator Figure Oakley® Frogskins™ Sunglasses Leonida Keys Crossbody Bag New Era® 9FORTY Snapback Hat Macca the Gator Magnetic Mirror Chunkee the Manatee Shot Glass Vice City Collectible Swizzle Spoon Vice City Razor Blade Keychain Leonida Keys Enamel Pin Set in Metal Tin Leonida Keys Sticker Pack in Stash Bag Double-Sided Souvenir Poster with Map of Leonida Polygon Interactive Switch Wheel Gaming • Quizzes • Grand Theft Auto Michael Franklin Trevor Lester Lamar Polygon Quiz W h i c h G T A V C h a r a c t e r A r e Y o u ? 8 Questions • 5 Characters Set aside what any of them do for a living. Underneath, Los Santos runs on five very different people: one restless, one patient, one with no filter, one who has already worked out how it ends, and one who has never once doubted himself. Eight ordinary questions, none of them about the job, will say which one you are. On The Wheel Michael Franklin Trevor Lester Lamar Spin The Wheel Block 01 of 08 0% Driven Question 01 A NEW CITY 01 You move somewhere new. What does your first week look like? Everybody arrives differently. A I picked the house first. Everything else arranges itself around that. B Working, learning the place, watching who does well here and how. C Introducing myself to everybody, loudly, inside about an hour. D I researched it for six months. I know it better than people who live there. E Telling everyone back home how well it is going before it is going at all. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 02 of 08 12% Driven Question 02 THE CAR 02 What are you driving, and what is playing in it? Be honest. This one is very revealing. A Something comfortable and sensible that I am quietly embarrassed by. B Something I worked for, kept clean, and I know exactly what it cost me. C Whatever was nearest, at a volume nobody in the area asked for. D I do not drive. I would rather not be out there at all. E Something louder than I can afford, and I will tell you what it is worth. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 03 of 08 25% Driven Question 03 THE CREDIT 03 Somebody takes credit for your work in a meeting. Eight seconds to decide what kind of person you are. A I let it go, and then feel worse about it for a week. B I say nothing, and I remember exactly who was in the room. C I say precisely what I think about it, at length, right then. D I already have a record of who did what. It will come up later. E I laugh, take a bit of their credit back, and we move on. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 04 of 08 38% Driven Question 04 THE DINNER 04 A family dinner is going badly. Where are you in it? Everybody has been at this dinner. A Paying for it, and wondering how it ended up like this. B Quiet. Watching. Working out when I can reasonably leave. C I am the reason it is going badly and I am having a lovely time. D I did not come. I was invited, and I did not come. E Talking the whole way through it, and genuinely lifting the mood. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 05 of 08 50% Driven Question 05 MONEY 05 A large amount of money lands in your lap. What happens to it? Nobody answers this the way they think they will. A A bigger house and a worse mood. B Invested, carefully, in the thing that gets me out. C Gone by Thursday and I could not tell you where. D Moved somewhere safe before anybody knows I have it. E Spent on something visible, immediately, so that everybody knows. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 06 of 08 62% Driven Question 06 THE PHONE 06 Your phone rings at the worst possible moment. Who is it, and do you pick up? A My kids. I let it ring, and then I feel terrible about it. B Somebody who needs something. I pick up, because I said I would. C Does not matter who. I am answering and they are not getting a word in. D I screen everything. I will call back when I am ready. E It is me calling them, and it is the fourth time today. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 07 of 08 75% Driven Question 07 THE MISREAD 07 What do people most often get wrong about you? The gap between how you read and how you are. A They think I have it all worked out. B They think this is as far as I am going. C They think I do not know exactly what I am doing. D They think I am not paying attention. E They think I do not mean a word of it. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 08 of 08 88% Driven Question 08 TEN YEARS ON 08 Ten years from now. Where are you? This is the one that decides it. A Trying to retire for the fourth time. B Out. Properly out, and it took exactly this long. C Exactly where I am now, and completely fine about it. D Somewhere quiet with a very good internet connection. E Three ideas in, and the next one is definitely the one. ← Back Pick one, then Next Switch To Me The Wheel Stops You Are These are temperaments, not resumes. Your answers keep landing on the same one, and it is rarely the one people expect of themselves. here --> Los Santos / Retired Michael Comfort / Restlessness / Regret You got everything and it did not help. Comfortable, restless, and quietly furious about being both. You bought the house, you got the life, and you have spent every year since wondering what it was supposed to be for. Why That Is You Michael is the only one of the five who is already successful when you meet him, which makes him the only one whose real problem is boredom. You picked the house first, and the rest of your life arranged itself around that one decision. A bad family dinner is one you are paying for, while wondering how it ended up like this. Ten years on you are trying to retire for the fourth time, and you will not manage it. Comfortable Restless Paying For It here --> Los Santos / Ambitious Franklin Ambition / Patience / Getting Out You are the only one with a plan to leave. Patient where the others are not, watchful where the others are loud, and the only one in Los Santos treating any of this as a route to somewhere better. Why That Is You Franklin is the one who arrives wanting out, and everything he does is measured against whether it moves him closer to that. You say nothing when somebody takes credit for your work, and you remember exactly who was in the room. Money gets invested carefully in the thing that gets you out, which nobody else here would even consider. People think this is as far as you are going. That is the single most useful thing they could believe. Patient Watchful Getting Out here --> Sandy Shores / Unfiltered Trevor No Filter / No Plan / Total Loyalty You say the thing everyone else is thinking. No filter, no plan, and no interest in pretending otherwise. You are the loudest person in any room by a distance, and the most loyal one in it by a wider distance than that. Why That Is You Trevor is the least predictable character in the game and the most quoted, because he says out loud what everybody else is being careful about. You introduce yourself to everyone, loudly, within an hour of arriving anywhere. Money is gone by Thursday and you genuinely could not tell anybody where it went. People think you do not know exactly what you are doing. You do, and that is the unsettling part. No Filter Unpredictable Fiercely Loyal here --> Los Santos / Calculating Lester Planning / Caution / Knowing Everything You worked out how it ends before it started. You do not go out, you do not improvise, and you have known the answer for a while. Everybody else is reacting. You are the only one who has read ahead. Why That Is You Lester is the one who sees the whole board, and he is written as the opposite of everybody around him: no volume, no impulse, all preparation. You researched the place for six months before you moved, and you know it better than people who grew up there. You screen every call and ring back when you are ready, which other people find rude and you find obvious. People think you are not paying attention. You have a record of exactly who did what, and it will come up. Prepared Screens Calls Reads Ahead here --> Los Santos / Relentless Lamar Confidence / Schemes / Never Doubts It You have never once doubted yourself. Relentless, funny and completely unbothered by the last four ideas not working. You are the reason the room is in a good mood, and the next one is definitely the one. Why That Is You Lamar is the character with the most confidence and the least evidence, and the game clearly likes him more for it. You told everyone back home how well it was going well before it was going at all. Money goes on something visible, immediately, because what is the point otherwise. People think you do not mean a word of it. You mean all of it, every time, which is why the next one is definitely the one.
